item.title: Phoenix Mahjong Club: A social hub for analog hobbies
item.description: The Phoenix Mahjong Club in Scottsdale, Arizona is the first member-based Mahjong club in the state, offering a social alternative to digital entertainment and providing a way for people to build meaningful connections away from their smartphones.

item.title: Cupid cash and Valentine's specials at Bucky's and Yavapai Casinos
item.description: Bucky's and Yavapai Casinos are offering a variety of Valentine's Day promotions, including Cupid Cash Drawings, Table Games Kisses and Cash Hot Seats, and romantic dinner specials, for players to win prizes and enjoy a romantic night out.

item.title: WM Phoenix Open partners with Waste Not to share surplus food
item.description: The nonprofit organization Waste Not is partnering with the WM Phoenix Open to redistribute unused food from the tournament to local residents in need. The initiative follows a successful effort last year that rescued more than 30,000 pounds of food from the event. The collaboration aims to support the one in seven Arizonans who face [...]

item.title: Elevated dining with runway views at Volanti restaurant
item.description: Volanti Restaurant at Scottsdale Airport offers a unique dining experience with runway views, accessible to the general public without a plane ticket or security screening, and features a menu of approachable fine dining with a variety of popular items and creative cocktails.

item.title: Volunteers boost WM Phoenix Open's fundraising success
item.description: The WM Phoenix Open is powered by over 3,500 volunteers who manage nearly every aspect of the tournament, which generated $18.1 million in proceeds for the local community last year and has given back over $226 million over nine decades.

item.title: Be Our Guest: Caffe Boa
item.description: Caffe Boa Ahwatukee is offering 50% off dining as part of CW7's "Be Our Guest" series, and features large portion sizes of Italian comfort food, imported wines, and a patio capable of hosting parties for over 50 people.

item.title: Layla's Bunnyville offers 'bunny therapy' for Valentine's Day
item.description: Layla's Bunnyville, a rabbit petting zoo run by a 15-year-old high school student in Tempe, is offering a Valentine's Day event that includes "bunny therapy" and a dessert experience for couples.

item.title: Spend a sunset with rescued pigs at 'Hogs and Kisses'
item.description: Better Piggies Rescue will host its "Hogs and Kisses: Date Night" fundraiser this Saturday, offering the public an opportunity to interact with rescued pigs while watching the sunset.

item.title: Desert Dubs Fest #5: 500+ VWs to gather for charity
item.description: Desert Dubs Fest #5 will bring over 500 air-cooled Volkswagens to Tumbleweed Park in Chandler on Saturday, featuring a custom-built 1967 VW Baja Beetle giveaway, food, a DJ, and raffle prizes, all to raise money for Phoenix Children's Hospital.

item.title: Aviation Institute of Maintenance readies students for aerospace jobs
item.description: The Aviation Institute of Maintenance in Phoenix offers a 21-month hands-on program that prepares students for high-paying careers in the aerospace industry, with graduates earning starting salaries of $70,000 to $80,000.
